body.x: Sense K will showcase smart pointing device and smartremote at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas,from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri).

Sense K is a tech-based start-up that was established in2017. Based on IoT technology and GIS technology, it develops input and controldevices that can interface with peripherals more conveniently. A smart pointingdevice is a device that provides users with a more convenient and enjoyableinput operation on a computer, and a smart remote is a device that provides auser interface to enjoy the functions of a smart TV fully.

Smart pointing device features ▲ Simultaneousimplementation of mouse and touch pad on one device ▲ convenient functionsaccording to user's work environment and work contents ▲ provide convenienceand enjoyment of computer work.

The Smart Remote also features: - a combination of atouchpad and a keypad for existing remote controller functions - simultaneouscontrol and input for enjoying smart TVs - a GIS based touch gesturerecognition technology - an intuitive and consistent way It is possible tocontrol the smart home device.

On the other hand, Seongnam IndustryPromotion Agency participating in CES 2019 is an organization that is in chargeof providing financial support for SMEs and venture companies in Seongnam. Ithelps companies with global investors and buyer networking and promotions. Italso actively supports the participation in CES 2019 as a part of the globalexport business development program. The following companies are participatingin CES 2019 with the support of Seongnam Industry Promotion Agency. ▲ ExoSystems ▲ Blue Feel ▲ Sense K ▲ iSenLab ▲ OWLFS ▲ 1Drop ▲ Ufrst ▲ ecarPlug
